Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms Conditions The Components of Scope of Work are as follows:

1. The vender shall provide onsite support for user maintenance and troubleshooting for day-to-da y problems pertaining to existing GCRI HMIS and intranet website named GCRI.Net. 2. One experienced software engineer will remain present at GCRI Ahmedabad during the office h ours. 3. The vender should have complete knowledge of existing GCRI HMIS modules and backend data base. 4. The vender shall develop New Modules / Forms / Alteration in existing Modules as per the requir ement raise by GCRI and the TimeLine for completion the assigned work will be decided after stu dying the process by GCRI IT Dept and Hospital Administrator. 5. Any type of Errors/Bug Fixing shall be resolved within one day. 6. Priority of every task will be defined by GCRI-IT Administration. 7. The vendor shall be responsible for data extraction at the time of migration from existing HMIS to New HMIS. 8. The vendor shall provide this service also at the satellite centers being managed by GCRI in Guj arat State. (At present like COC-Vasna, Siddhpur, Rajkot & Bhavnagar) ensuring their smooth ope rations 24 x 7. 9. Minor updating like (i) Alternation in Reports designs or changes in software module screens (ii) Any data field addition and updating existing database structure etc. These types of tasks also sh all be performed by the vendor and it will be a part of this contract. 10. New Requirements like (i) Data Generation as per such special requirement (ii) To Up gradation /Alteration in existing Reports designs OR Changes in software module OR its screen shall be a p art of this contract. 11. To submit complete User Manuals, Data Dictionaries for each New / Upgraded software module with periodically updation. 12. To Maintain and submit the details of call log records of day-to-day work done by the vendor. 13. The vendor should provide operating training to users with periodically updation. 14. The vendor shall ensure proper installation of existing HMIS on appropriate servers along with a ssociated database and other related environmental software for smooth functioning. 15. Troubleshooting and problem solving with regards to functioning of HMIS. 16. Coordination for troubleshooting with OEMs of other external systems connected directly or indi rectly with existing HMIS through software or hardware. 17. The Response Time / Downtime for any call / complaint logged should not be more than 2 hours. 18. The vendor shall provide proper guidance regarding hardware/software/environmental peripher als for smooth functioning. 19. Generating shall ensure data extraction / summary / statistics as and when required by institute . 20. Providing Continuous Tuning and Configuration of Database (SQL Server) and Web Server (IIS) f or ensuring smooth performance of HMIS round the clock. ABDM Compliance and Existing System Migration 1. The vendor shall declare and commit to a definite timeline for completing th e migration, necessary modifications, integration and implementation of the e xisting system to ensure compliance with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Missio n (ABDM) guidelines and requirements. 2. The vendor shall submit a detailed migration and implementation schedule, clearly specifying the activities, milestones, deliverables and timelines for achi eving complete ABDM compliance. The schedule shall be submitted to the Inst itute for review and approval before commencement of the migration work.

3. The vendor shall complete the entire migration and achieve the required AB DM compliance within the timeline approved by the Institute. 4. Upon completion of the migration, the Institute shall verify the implemented system, assess compliance with the applicable ABDM requirements and issue formal acceptance and certification of successful completion. 5. In case of delay beyond the approved completion deadline, a penalty of @Rs. 500 per day shall be levied until successful completion of the migration and A BDM compliance, as verified and accepted by the Institute. This penalty shall be levied over and above any other penalties applicable under the contract an d shall not be counted towards, included in, or subject to the maximum penalt y ceiling of 10% of the total contract value. 6. The vendor shall ensure that the migration and implementation activities do not adversely affect the existing operational system, data integrity, patient se rvices or ongoing hospital operations. Penalty Clause · A Penalty of @Rs.500 per Bug/Error shall be applicable on non-performance/malfunction of docum ented feature in all Applications. i.e. Bugs/Errors must not be accepted. · A penalty @Rs.1000 per Day for delay in completion of task can be applied in case of improper ju stification. · A penalty @Rs.500 per day shall be levied for the absence of the designated E ngineer during the Institute's official working days. · For Institute's official non-working days/hours : During the Institute's official no n-working days/hours, including weekends and public holidays, the service pro vider shall ensure that any reported software service breakdown is attended to by a qualified Engineer within one (1) hour of receiving the complaint. The one -hour timeline shall refer to the initial response and commencement of trouble shooting, either remotely or through physical attendance, as required by the n ature of the breakdown. It shall not be construed as the time allowed for compl ete resolution. In case the service provider fails to respond and commence tro ubleshooting within the stipulated one-hour period, a penalty of ₹500 per day s hall be applicable until the Engineer attends to the reported breakdown and co mmences troubleshooting. · The amount of such penalties shall be subject to a maximum limit of 10% of the annual contract v alue. Total amount of penalties up to maximum limit will be sufficient to cause for termination of t he contract. Termination of Contract The Institute may, without prejudice to any other remedy for breach of contract, by written notice of defau lt sent to the company, terminate the Contract in whole or part. 1. If the company stop performing the contract or withdraw the activity to perform the contract. 2. If the company breach any terms & conditions of the contract or do not perform the contract in w hole or part.

3. If the company do not follow the written/oral instructions given by Institute. 4. If the company does not perform the contract up to the satisfactory level even after regular feedb ack from the Institute. 5. Director, GCRI shall have a right to discontinue the contract with prior notice of 4 (Four) months d uring the contract period. .
